beliefs: Every letter other than l/L is replaced by its predecessor in the alphabet (a->z, b->a, ..., A->Z, B->A) [E1, E9, E10]
A run of consecutive l/L collapses to a single 'l'/'L' [E2, E3, E5, E13]
When a run of l/L follows a letter, the preceding letter is shifted to its predecessor and the run becomes a single 'l'/'L' [E13, E14, E23]
When a run of l/L follows a letter and is followed by a tail, the first tail character is dropped and the rest kept verbatim [E20, E21, E22, E23, E24, E25]
When a run of l/L is at the start of the string (no preceding letter), it becomes 'k'/'K' [E2, E3, E6, E7]
A single l/L after a letter is left as 'l'/'L' (not shifted) and the following characters are kept verbatim [E9, E10, E11]
A single l/L after a digit or space is left unchanged [E6, E8]
Case is preserved for all transformations [E1, E2, E3]
The l/L handling is special-cased and does not follow the general predecessor shift [E2, E5, E9, E10]
